player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''The Rattler''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in August 2001.

starting.card: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe

description: A good tie deck with plenty of tallon rolls.
cards: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe
notes: Posted 1 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted in the unheaded first section (8): Set Your Course For Alderaan ('SYCFA'), Death Star ('D'), Death Star: Docking Bay 327 ('D db'), Alderaan, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Fanfare and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement ('TINT/OE'); these count toward the 60. Three Effects start, so no single starting Effect is singled out.

Posted 'D WR' dested Death Star: War Room and 'D assault squadron' dested Death Star Assault Squadron, following the poster's 'D' = Death Star shorthand; 'Wakelimi' dested Wakeelmui; 'endor', 'kashyyk', 'sullust' and 'Alderaan' dested the Dark system pages.
Posted '6x tallon roll' dested the combo Dark Maneuvers & Tallon Roll: the strategy says 'the tallon rolls are combo cards, not the premeire ones'.
Posted 'fanfare(pull your grabber)' dested the Tatooine Effect Fanfare (the Reflections III Defensive Shield came later).
Posted '2x grabber' is shown as posted (type UNKNOWN): pre-Coruscant Dark grabbers include There'll Be Hell To Pay and Do They Have A Code Clearance?, and the post does not say which.
Posted 'maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'Vader w/saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'com. merrejek' dested Commander Merrejk; 'U-3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).

Posted 'black squad tie', 'scythe tie' and 'obsidian tie' dested Black Squadron TIE, Scythe Squadron TIE and Obsidian Squadron TIE; 'dreadnaught' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'emperors shiled' dested The Emperor's Shield.

Posted 'twileck' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'SFS/control' (under Interrupts) dested Control & Set For Stun; 'SFS' (under Effects) dested Sienar Fleet Systems; 'short range fighters' dested the Special Edition Short-range Fighters; 'overload(kills cannons+missiles)' dested Overload.
Posted 'resistence' dested the Jabba's Palace Effect Resistance (the Reflections III shield came later); 'Dreaded imp. fleet' dested Dreaded Imperial Starfleet.
